_comment: Curated overrides applied LAST, for lines where the encounter data is systematically misleading and no general rule fixes them without breaking others. Each entry must cite the official grounds. Overrides are transparent: the record's source becomes 'override', the rationale names what the pipeline would have said, and the validation report lists them. Keep this file SHORT — every entry is a confession that the model missed something; prefer fixing rules when a pattern repeats.

headbutt-tree bug of Johto woods (Azalea/Ilex surrounds); its cave-adjacent Alola rows are berry-pile cameos

the garbage-bag Pokémon (already curated in the industrial archetype); its BW route grass spawns say meadow but its identity and city-adjacent spawns (Alola) are trash/urban
man-made gear Pokémon; its Unova home is Chargestone Cave, and SwSh Wild Area route spam says meadow — neither reflects the gear/machinery identity the industrial section exists for
